chunks: A Muslim man is not made upright except by three things: understanding the religion, moderation in livelihood, and patience in affliction.

key_terms.اَلتَّفَقُّهِ: deep understanding and sound comprehension, especially in religion
key_terms.اَلتَّقْدِيرِ: measured management, moderation, and prudent planning
key_terms.اَلدِّينِ: the religion, meaning the divinely ordained way of life

ai.seo_question: What qualities does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say are necessary for a Muslim to be upright?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that a sound Muslim life rests on three foundations: deep understanding of religion, wise management of one's livelihood, and patience when trials strike. The hadith joins spiritual understanding, practical economic balance, and moral endurance as essential qualities of upright character.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3618 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"A Muslim cannot be righteous except through three qualities: understanding the religion, managing livelihood wisely, and exercising patience in adversity."
